subject: Recap & MPA: Redwood x Horizon Analytics — milestones, owners, dates
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Saha <psaha@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Redwood + Horizon discovery — next steps & MPA draft

Hi Priya (and team),

Thanks again for the productive call earlier — appreciate the clarity on the endpoint latency issues and model cost sensitivity. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MPA) for the next 8 weeks. Please skim and confirm stakeholders/timing so we can lock the trial and procurement path.

Key pain & goals we heard
- Current constraints: 90% of inference calls must be <150ms P95; existing vendor averages ~320ms.
- Cost pressure: target to reduce per-1k token inference spend by ~30% vs current provider.
- Compliance: data residency and audit logs required for EU & US business units.

Proposed MPA milestones (draft)
1) Week 0–1: Trial kick-off — provide sample data, grant access to test environment (owner: Horizon Eng)
2) Week 2: Latency & cost baseline report (owner: Redwood Eng — David)
3) Week 4: Optimization pass (batching/quantization config) + result validation (owner: Redwood + Horizon Eng)
4) Week 6: Security questionnaire completed & procurement packet submitted (owner: Horizon Procurement + Redwood Sales)
5) Week 8: Exec review & decision (owner: Horizon Execs + Redwood Account Exec)

Stakeholders (please confirm):
- Horizon: Priya Saha (Product), Rajiv Patel (Eng lead, will be trial owner?), Anita Gomez (Procurement)
- Redwood: David Kim (AE), Grace O'Connor (Solutions Eng), Evelyn Hart (Security/compliance)

Open asks for Horizon
- Confirm trial owner (name + email) and sample dataset delivery date (ideally by Tue 12/1).
- Confirm procurement contact and any specific PO/terms cadence.

Open asks from Redwood
- We will provision a private trial in your AWS account (VPC peering) — need a brief network checklist (Grace will send).
- Please review attached MPA draft (Redwood_Roadmap_MPA_draft_v1.pdf) and flag any changes.

Next steps
- If this looks right, can we get a 30-min sync with Rajiv + Procurement next week to lock the kick-off?
- I'll update the MPA and share a DocuSign when we have confirmation on owners/dates.

Thanks again — excited to move forward.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_Roadmap_MPA_draft_v1.pdf (MPA draft, milestones & acceptance criteria)
From: Priya Saha <psaha@horizon-analytics.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rpatel@horizon-analytics.com>, Anita Gomez <procurement@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood + Horizon discovery — next steps & MPA draft

Thanks David — very helpful summary. A few quick notes:

1) Stakeholders: Rajiv is the right engineering owner; adding Saira Menon (Data Platform) — saira.menon@horizon-analytics.com — she'll own dataset delivery and schema.
2) Procurement: Anita is procurement lead (procurement@horizon-analytics.com). Typical timeline is 4–6 weeks after we submit the packet, but we can fast-track for pilots.
3) P95 target: we'll also measure 99th percentile for a subset of production traffic — ok if that's in the baseline report.

Meeting: Rajiv and Anita are available Mon 11/30 10:00–11:00 PT for a 30-min kick-off. Does that work for Redwood?

I reviewed the MPA and left 2 small comments (acceptance criteria for data retention and a note on SLA escalation). Overall looks good.

Happy to confirm once Rajiv accepts the calendar invite.
Best,
Priya
Product Lead, Horizon Analytics

On Sat, Nov 28, 2026 at 1:02 PM David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai> wrote:

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood + Horizon discovery — next steps & MPA draft

Thanks, David — I'll own the Trial provisioning and network checklist. A couple of technical clarifications to add to the MPA before we share with Rajiv:

- We will provision a dedicated test pool with a request template (GPU size, expected concurrent sessions). Need Horizon to confirm expected RPS and average sequence length for the subset (Saira will help).
- For latency testing we'll run both synthetic (short prompts) and replayed production traces (anonymized) — will include P95 and P99 in the Week 2 baseline.

I attached a short trial-specs template (trial-specs.xlsx) with the fields Horizon should fill. Priya — can you route to Saira + Rajiv before the Mon sync?

On the Procurement side Evelyn, can you prepare a short compliance blurb (SOC2 scope, data retention options) I can attach to the packet?

I'll join Mon at 10:00 PT.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Great — calendar invite sent for Mon 11/30 10:00 PT. Thanks Priya for adding Saira and Anita.

I updated the MPA with the changes Grace and Priya suggested (retention acceptance criteria and trial provisioning notes) and uploaded the new version here: https://redwood.app/drive/MPA/HZ-2026-1128/Redwood_Roadmap_MPA_v1.1.pdf

Next actions for this week:
- Horizon: Saira/Rajiv — fill and return trial-specs.xlsx by Tue 12/1 EOD.
- Horizon Procurement: Anita — if you can share any standard PO language or timing that helps us prepare the packet earlier.
- Redwood: Evelyn — short compliance note (SOC2 scope + logs) by Tue morning; Grace — network checklist + trial provisioning steps.

I will generate the DocuSign MPA once owners/dates are confirmed in the Monday call.

Thanks everyone — see you on Mon.
Best,
David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
